tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind views and cards.

tokens.name: view
tokens.usage: Main content view, input fields, window chrome body.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Header bar background.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar background.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and boxed lists.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: default button, segmented control track, table header, neutral badge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Input borders, outline-button ring, switch off-track. 3:1 or better on view and bg in every theme.

tokens.name: cardline
tokens.usage: Card and boxed-list border; alias of line.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, view, head, side, card, sunk and sel. 4.5:1 or better in every theme.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table cells, body copy inside callouts. Passes on every surface and tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, subtitles, help text, table headings, counts. 4.5:1 or better on bg, view, head, side, card, sunk and sel in every theme.

tokens.name: acc
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, switch on, checkbox accent, focused input border, active tab underline. onacc on it passes 4.5:1 in every theme. In Fjord dark it is 2.85:1 against sunk: keep primary buttons off sunken areas there.

tokens.name: acch
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of acc fills; always keeps onacc legible (darker in light themes, lighter in Isbre dark and Rim dark).

tokens.name: accsoft
tokens.usage: Info callout and accent badge background; pair with accink.

tokens.name: accink
tokens.usage: Text on accsoft and sel: active nav item, info callout heading, accent badge.

tokens.name: onacc
tokens.usage: Text and icons on acc and acch fills. White in Fjord, Fjord dark, Isbre and Rim; dark ink in Isbre dark and Rim dark, where the accent lightens.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: Selected nav item and selected table row background.

tokens.name: p50
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 50: faintest tint.

tokens.name: p100
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 100: same value as accsoft and sel.

tokens.name: p200
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 200: 3px focus halo around a focused input (the halo supplements the acc border, which carries the contrast).

tokens.name: p300
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 300.

tokens.name: p400
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 400.

tokens.name: p500
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 500: the brand blue; same value as acc.

tokens.name: p600
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 600: same value as acch.

tokens.name: p700
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 700: same value as accink.

tokens.name: p800
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 800.

tokens.name: p900
tokens.usage: Primary ramp 900: deepest.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on oksoft.

tokens.name: oksoft
tokens.usage: Success callout and badge background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on warnsoft.

tokens.name: warnsoft
tokens.usage: Warning callout and badge background.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error text, error help text, error input border; legible on badsoft and view.

tokens.name: badsoft
tokens.usage: Danger callout and badge background; error input halo.

tokens.name: badfill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill; white text on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal dialogs (35% black, same in every theme).

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: 3px glow around a focused text field, outside its acc border (the border carries the contrast). Pale ramp blue in light themes, the soft accent tint in dark ones.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and console background: dark in every theme.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text on term-bg (15:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: term-accent
tokens.usage: Terminal prompt and highlights on term-bg (8.5:1 or better in every theme).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page-level hero line; one per screen at most.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a view or card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Æ Ø Å æ ø å Þ ð Ä Ö — NOK 1 234.50
styles.usage: Default text; inputs use the same size.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and row subtitles, in muted.

styles.name: cap
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow over a section, in muted. Write the text in sentence case; the style uppercases it.

tokens.name: r
tokens.usage: Windows, cards, boxed lists.

tokens.name: rs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, callouts, segmented control, swatches.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons and badges.

radius.note: Radii vary by family: Fjord 12 / 8 / 999, Isbre 8 / 6 / 999, Rim 4 / 3 / 4 (dark variants match their light ones). Values here are Fjord; Isbre and Rim override them in components/bundle.css.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The one elevation: windows and floating surfaces. Isbre and Rim (light and dark) use none: hairlines only. Cards and lists use a cardline border instead.

spacing.note: 4px base. Components keep their own exact paddings; use these steps for layout between and around them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest: icon to its label inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; inside compact groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related items: a label and its help text group, rows of chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between fields and between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content padding inside panes and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a view.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page margin on wide views.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around a StatusPage; large vertical breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on web pages.
